name: The Number Key
description: Pick up the Number, hold it in the Thought Bubble, and use Held Item to power Repeat.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: That floating 3 is a Number. Use Pick Up first so Zoey carries it in the Thought Bubble.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: The Thought Bubble now holds the number. Set Repeat to use Held Item, and it will read the 3 you're carrying.

intro.speaker: Guide
intro.text: Put one Step inside Repeat. Held Item makes that Step run three times, enough to reach the goal.

hints.text: Start with Pick Up on the 3. The Number appears in the Thought Bubble after Zoey picks it up.
Use Held Item as the Repeat count, then put Step inside Repeat. The held 3 repeats Step three times.
